translations.1: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking to him.
translations.2: Command Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, that he lift the fire-pans from among the burned ones, and scatter the fire there — for they have become consecrated.
translations.3: As for the fire-pans of these men who sinned against their own souls, let them be made into thin beaten plates, a covering for the altar — for since they presented them before God they have become consecrated, and they shall be a sign for the sons of Israel.
translations.4: And Eleazar the priest took the copper fire-pans which the burned ones had presented, and they beat them into plates for the altar —
translations.5: a memorial for the sons of Israel, so that no outsider who is not of the lineage of Aaron shall draw near to burn incense before God, and that none be like Korah and his assembly — as God laid down by the hand of Moses concerning him.
translations.6: And the whole congregation of the sons of Israel complained on the next day against Moses and Aaron, saying: 'You two have killed from the nation of God.'
translations.7: And when they had gathered against the two of them, they turned toward the tent of the assembly — and behold, the light of God appeared in the cloud.
translations.8: And Moses and Aaron came forward before the tent of the assembly.
translations.9: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking to him.
translations.10: 'If you remove yourselves from among this congregation, I shall destroy them in the twinkling of an eye.' And the two of them fell upon their faces.
translations.11: And Moses said to Aaron: 'Take the fire-pan, and place upon it fire from the altar, and cast incense upon it, and go with it quickly to the congregation, and seek forgiveness for them — for the wrath has gone forth from before God, and the plague has already begun among them.'
translations.12: And Aaron took it, just as Moses had said, and he came to the midst of the assembly — and behold, the pestilence had already begun among them; and he burned the incense, and sought forgiveness for them.
translations.13: And he stood between the dead and the living, and the pestilence was held back.
translations.14: And the number of those who died in that pestilence was fourteen thousand and seven hundred — besides those who died on account of Korah.
translations.15: Then Aaron returned to Moses, to the entrance of the tent of the assembly, and the pestilence had been held back.
translations.16: Then God spoke to Moses, speaking to him.
translations.17: 'Command the sons of Israel, and take from them a staff, one staff for each father's house, from their nobles, for the houses of their fathers — twelve staves; and write the name of each man upon his staff.
translations.18: And Aaron's name — write it upon the staff of Levi; for you are to take but one staff for the whole body of the houses of their fathers.'
translations.19: 'And place them in the tent of the assembly, before the testimony, where I shall meet you there.'
translations.20: 'And the man whom I shall choose — his staff shall put forth branches, so that I may quiet away from Me the complaining of the sons of Israel, which they are complaining against you.'
translations.21: And Moses spoke this to the sons of Israel, and all their nobles gave to him a staff, one staff for each noble, for the houses of their fathers — twelve staves; and Aaron's staff was among their staves.
translations.22: And Moses placed them before God, in the tent of the testimony.
translations.23: And when the next day came, Moses entered the tent of the testimony — and behold, the staff of Aaron, which was for the house of Levi, had put forth branches: it had brought out branches, and had burst into blossom, and had formed almonds.
translations.24: And Moses brought out all the staves from before God to all the sons of Israel, and each one looked at his own staff and took it.
translations.25: Then God said to Moses: 'Return Aaron's staff before the testimony, to be kept as a sign for those who are rebellious, that their complaining against Me may be brought to an end, and they shall not perish.'
translations.26: And Moses did as God had commanded him in this.
translations.27: Then the sons of Israel said to Moses: 'Behold, some of us have died and some of us have perished — so we are all doomed.'
translations.28: And if every one who draws near to the dwelling of God is destroyed, then behold — we are perishing, we are dying.'
